summary: Kirmes Event Detail Page - Expanded Row Features tested successfully. All features working as expected: fast meter-data API with limit=1, yellow background for rows without EMU meter, German payment status translations, compact inline expanded row layout with EMU data and invoice info.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Kirmes Event Detail Page expanded row features fully tested. The desktop table at /kirmes/{eventId} shows all headers (Firma, Name, Geschäft, Platz, Anschl., Einbau, Ausbau, Verbr., Preis, Status). Rows without EMU meter have bg-amber-50 yellow background. Payment status labels show German translations (pending_payment -> Ausstehend, abgerechnet -> Abgerechnet). Expanded rows show compact inline layout with contact info, EMU data (kW/V/A/Hz, Online/Offline), action buttons (Neu verknüpfen, Trennen, QR, Zählerdaten & Export), and invoice info (RE number, date, amount, PDF, E-Mail buttons).

yellow_background_no_meter.description: Rows WITHOUT linked EMU meter have bg-amber-50/60 yellow background. Row WITH meter (Achterbahn Müller) does NOT have yellow background.
